description.en: The name of the application that was used to record the live stream.

description.zh: 录制时使用的直播域名。
description.en: The domain name of the recorded live stream.

description.zh: 录制操作（开始直播节目录制）的结束时间。需晚于开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The query is performed based on the time range during which the required live streams were recorded. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.
The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.
The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
结果排序。取值：

- **CreationTime:Desc**（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。
- **CreationTime:Asc**：按创建时间升序。
description.en:
The sorting rule of the results. Valid values:

*   **CreationTime:Desc**: The results are sorted in reverse chronological order based on the creation time.
*   **CreationTime:Asc**: The results are sorted in chronological order based on the creation time.

description.zh: 录制操作（开始直播节目录制）的开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. The query is performed based on the time range during which the required live streams were recorded. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 录制时使用的直播流名称。
description.en: The name of the recorded live stream.

title.zh: 获取直播转点播视频列表

descriptions.zh: 最多支持获取指定筛选条件的前5000条。
descriptions.en: You can query up to 5,000 videos based on the specified filter condition.
